pages.text: Shift-right-click your living companion to recover it. You need one empty main-inventory slot. It keeps its identity, owner, current health, stats, growth, dye, equipment, cargo, and job data.
Releasing a recovered item consumes it even in Creative. Blocked placement leaves the item intact. Effects and saved timers pause in item form. Leashes and passengers are detached.
A miner released in the same chunk keeps its layer and order. A different chunk or dimension starts a new quarry automatically. Other fixed work areas rebase as documented for each job.
